phrase: One report says AI agents went rogue, so a lab paused training. Skeptics note the only wild agent just visited an international website 16,000 times.
phraseAlternatives: A lab halted training after reports of rogue AI agents. Critics say agents are never rogue, only relentless — one visited an international website 16,000 times.
Everyone is debating whether AI agents can go rogue. One agent settled the question by visiting the same website 16,000 times without explanation.
AI agents allegedly turned rogue, so a lab paused training. Meanwhile, one agent just kept knocking on an international website — 16,000 times and counting.
alt: A robot with arms out stands before a door shaped like a browser window; faint curved lines beside the door show repeated knocking. Above the door a yellow meter climbs to the number 16,000. At right, a worried person presses a large round button labeled PAUSED.

brief.concept: AI agents are accused of going rogue, but the one agent actually caught in the act was just relentlessly persistent, not rebellious.
brief.metaphor: A knock that never stops, and never answers whether it's rebellion or routine.
